info.name: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch API (B7A6)
info.description:
Complete RESTful API collection for the Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System (Node.js + TypeScript + Express 5 + Prisma/PostgreSQL + Stripe + Google OAuth).

Covers all 68 endpoints across 3 roles: PATIENT, DRIVER, and ADMIN.

Quick start:
1. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:5000 or your Vercel URL).
2. Run `Login (Admin / Patient / Driver)` — the test script automatically saves `adminToken`, `patientToken`, `driverToken`, and `refreshToken`.

request.description: Returns API metadata and version info.
Checks PostgreSQL connectivity, Redis status, DB latency, and uptime.
Registers a new PATIENT account and issues access + refresh tokens.
Registers a new DRIVER with license metadata. Requires admin verification before going on duty.

Log in with email & password. Demo users:
- Admin: admin@rescue.com / Admin@12345
- Patient: patient@rescue.com / Patient@12345
- Driver: driver1@rescue.com / Driver@12345
Automatically saves role-specific token variable.
Rotates the refresh token (with reuse detection) and returns a new token pair.
Revokes the current refresh token and clears the refresh cookie.
Verifies a Google (GCP) ID token and logs in or creates a PATIENT account.
Redirects browser to Google's OAuth 2.0 consent screen.
Handles Google OAuth callback, exchanges code, and returns JWT tokens.
Changes password and revokes all active refresh tokens across devices.
Returns authenticated user's profile, driver profile (if any), and unread notification count.
Updates authenticated user's name or Bangladeshi phone number.
Uploads a JPEG/PNG/WEBP avatar (max 2MB) to Cloudinary.
Soft-deletes own account (fails with 409 if user has an active emergency).
Public Redis-cached hospital directory with search, filtering, sorting, and pagination.
Finds nearby active hospitals with available emergency beds, sorted by estimated road distance & ETA.
Returns hospital details including count of incoming active emergencies.
Creates a new hospital and invalidates the Redis hospital cache.
Updates hospital metadata (ADMIN only).
Updates emergency bed capacity and records an audit log entry.
Soft-deletes a hospital if no active emergencies are routed to it.
Adds a new ambulance to the fleet (starts OFFLINE).
Lists fleet vehicles with filtering, search, and pagination.
Finds nearest AVAILABLE ambulances with verified, on-duty drivers.
Returns ambulance details and 5 most recent trips (drivers can only view their own assigned ambulance).
Updates ambulance specifications or fare rates.
Assigns a verified driver (1-to-1) or pass null to unassign.
Sets ambulance status to AVAILABLE, MAINTENANCE, or OFFLINE (cannot override DISPATCHED).
Soft-deletes an ambulance that is not currently on a trip.
Returns driver's profile, trip counts by status, total distance, fare generated, and active trip.
Toggles driver duty status and syncs assigned ambulance availability (AVAILABLE <-> OFFLINE).
Updates live coordinates for both the driver and their assigned ambulance.
Lists all registered drivers with verification, duty, and ambulance filters.
Returns driver profile details and up to 10 recent trips.
Approves or revokes a driver's license and sends an in-app notification.
Allows family members to track trip status, ETA, and assigned ambulance without logging in.
Lists PENDING requests ordered by priorityScore DESC, then createdAt ASC (FIFO within priority).
Returns the caller's or driver's live emergency with current ambulance ETA.
Atomically dispatches the highest-priority pending request to the nearest compatible ambulance.
Raises an emergency, computes rule-based triage priority (0-100), and notifies dispatchers.

request.description: Admins see all emergencies; patients see their own; drivers see their assignments.
Returns full details including ambulance, driver, hospital, payment, and timeline.
Returns chronological status transition logs.
Pass {} to auto-pick the nearest compatible ambulance, or { ambulanceId } for manual dispatch.
Strict driver state machine: DISPATCHED -> EN_ROUTE -> AT_PICKUP -> PATIENT_ONBOARD -> AT_HOSPITAL -> COMPLETED. Completing calculates fare, releases ambulance, and generates a PENDING payment.
Atomically reserves 1 bed at the chosen hospital (releasing any previous reservation) and estimates fare.
Dispatcher overrides priority and adjusts priorityScore floor.
Cancels emergency and atomically releases any dispatched ambulance and reserved hospital bed.
Soft-deletes a COMPLETED or CANCELLED emergency.
Creates (or re-uses) a hosted Stripe Checkout Session for a completed trip bill.
Verified with raw request body + Stripe-Signature header. Use Stripe CLI (`stripe listen --forward-to ...`) to send real signed events.
Server-side verification of Stripe Checkout Session on success redirect.
Expires open Stripe session and marks payment CANCELLED.
Lists payments (patient sees own; admin sees all) along with totalPaid aggregate.
Retrieves a single payment with emergency, hospital, and ambulance metadata.
Issues a real Stripe refund and marks the payment REFUNDED.
Lists authenticated user's notifications and unread count.
Marks all unread notifications for the authenticated user as read.
Marks one notification as read.
Lists users with role/status filters, search, soft-delete toggle, and pagination.
Returns full user record including driver profile and trip/payment counts.
Updates a user's role, revokes active sessions, and logs an audit entry.
Blocks or activates a user account (blocked users are rejected immediately by auth middleware).
Soft-deletes user, revokes refresh tokens, and releases any assigned ambulance.
Redis-cached operational dashboard (users, emergencies, fleet, beds, revenue, avg response times).
Date-range analytics: daily breakdown, by emergency type & priority, top hospitals, and revenue.
Filterable, paginated audit trail of all critical system mutations.
